a.lede: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.
a.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know

b.lede: Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadership, and scaling companies both inside and outside traditional startup hubs.
b.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
